terms.label: Applicant is an Estonian citizen
terms.definition: The applicant holds Estonian citizenship per the population registry.

anchors.quote: An Estonian citizen who has at least a secondary education, has active legal capacity and is proficient in Estonian to the extent provided by law or on the basis thereof may be employed in the service.
anchors.note: Primary citizenship basis for appointment under § 14(1).

terms.label: Applicant is a citizen of another EU Member State
terms.definition: The applicant holds citizenship of a Member State of the European Union other than Estonia per the population register (the § 14 (2) alternative to Estonian citizenship; exclusive of ee_citizen).

anchors.quote: A citizen of a Member State of the European Union who conforms to the requirements established by law and on the basis thereof may also be employed in the service.

terms.label: Applicant has at least secondary education
terms.definition: The applicant's recorded education is at least at secondary level.

anchors.quote: An Estonian citizen who has at least a secondary education, has active legal capacity and is proficient in Estonian to the extent provided by law or on the basis thereof may be employed in the service.

terms.label: Applicant speaks Estonian at required level
terms.definition: The applicant meets the statutory Estonian language requirement.

anchors.quote: An Estonian citizen who has at least a secondary education, has active legal capacity and is proficient in Estonian to the extent provided by law or on the basis thereof may be employed in the service.

terms.label: Applicant has active legal capacity
terms.definition: The applicant has active legal capacity.

anchors.quote: An Estonian citizen who has at least a secondary education, has active legal capacity and is proficient in Estonian to the extent provided by law or on the basis thereof may be employed in the service.
anchors.note: Full legal capacity is required for appointment.

terms.label: Applicant has a conviction for an intentional crime
terms.definition: Criminal records show a standing conviction for an intentional crime.

anchors.quote: The following person may not be employed in service: 1) who is under punishment for an intentionally committed criminal offence;
anchors.note: Bar on appointment for intentional-crime convictions.

terms.label: Applicant declares no § 15 4) family conflict
terms.definition: The applicant confirms they are not a close relative of a supervising official per § 15 4).

anchors.quote: The following person may not be employed in service: ... 4) who is a spouse or a partner in the marriage-like relationship (hereinafter unmarried partner) or a grandparent, a parent of an official who has direct control over the corresponding post, or a parent or a descendant of the parent, including a child and grandchild, of a spouse or an unmarried partner.
anchors.note: User-provided declaration that § 15 4) family-conflict bar does not apply.
